name: build-v2
description: Execute one slice of a build document inside strict boundaries: the spec is the only source of requirements, the source set is computed from git, a path outside the slice's named paths is reported or the run stops, a failing or skipped check is reported with its output and the card does not move. The portable build core of the skills v2 rebuild; the -v2 suffix stays while v1 build is installed and both are renamed at cutover.
